title: Delivery Policy
updated: PLACEHOLDER - add last updated date in the CMS
body:
Delivery timing and cost depend on the product, quantity, your location, distance and overall order size. Jumbo Sales does not publish fixed delivery prices because these vary by order.

To request a delivery quote, contact Jumbo Sales on WhatsApp or by phone with your location and the products you need. We will confirm delivery availability and cost before you order.
